_comment: Rename this file to orgs.json and fill in the REQUIRED fields. Everything else is auto-discoverable — see ONBOARDING.md. NEVER commit orgs.json to version control.

my_org._comment_required: REQUIRED — 5 fields from Adobe Developer Console (OAuth Server-to-Server credential). This is all you need to connect.
my_org.client_secret: <from Developer Console → click Retrieve client secret>
my_org.org_id: <XXXX@AdobeOrg — top-right corner of Developer Console project>
my_org.sandbox: <your default sandbox name, e.g. prod or dev>
my_org._comment_optional: OPTIONAL — leave these out on first connect. Run /aep-mcp-setup or use the MCP tools to auto-discover and paste in the values. You can also edit manually at any time.
my_org._comment_sandboxes: Short aliases → full sandbox names. Lets you say 'switch to dev' or 'switch to prod'. Discover full names with: list_sandboxes
my_org._comment_namespaces: Primary identity namespace per sandbox. Discover with: list_identity_namespaces. 'primary' = namespace code (e.g. Email, CRMID), 'primary_id' = integer ID, 'xdm_identity_map_key' = key used in XDM identityMap (usually same as primary).
my_org._comment_merge_policies: Merge policy UUIDs per sandbox. Discover with: list_merge_policies. 'primary' is the default merge policy; 'secondary' is optional for Edge/streaming contexts.

profiles._comment_multi_org: Add more profiles here for additional orgs or clients. Switch at runtime: switch_org_profile('client_b')
